system.description: Whenever anyone concealed by your use of the Force Haze Talent attacks, you maintain Total Concealment without having to make another Use the Force check. Only those who do not attack remain concealed; the attacker no longer has Total Concealment, even when using his Talent.

prerequisite.text: Clear Mind talent, and Force Haze talent

nodes.text: Clear Mind talent, and Force Haze talent
